description: A shell script for testing the behavior of 'git svn dcommit' with non-UTF8 commit messages, specifically testing non-UTF8 encodings like ISO-8859-1 and EUC-JP in a version control workflow.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive name.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the subsequent command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
